title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to display a custom Application Version (e.g., from W1 28.0 to YUN ZHU 28.0)
summary: Display a custom Application Version in Business Central by subscribing to the GetApplicationVersion event in codeunit 2000000001 Version Triggers. This technique allows you to modify the version string shown in Help & Support, useful for adding company names or custom identifiers to the default version display.
key_points: Subscribe to the GetApplicationVersion event in codeunit 2000000001 Version Triggers to customize the application version text
The Help & Support page shows the standard version format like W1 28.0 with platform and application build numbers
Use codeunit 9015 Application System Constants to retrieve the original version string programmatically
Best practice is to append custom text to the original application version rather than replacing it entirely

quotes.text: Did you know that we can display a custom Application Version?
quotes.why_it_matters: Introduces the capability to modify the version string displayed to users in Business Central

quotes.text: This is achieved by leveraging the following event. codeunit 2000000001 "Version Triggers" -> procedure GetApplicationVersion
quotes.why_it_matters: Specifies the exact event and codeunit developers must use to implement custom version display
